changelog:
Initial release — provides comprehensive, brand-neutral PC building consultation for first-time builders.

- Guides users through use case analysis, budget split, component selection, and compatibility checks.
- Covers CPU, GPU, RAM, storage, motherboard, PSU, cooler, and case airflow decisions in logical order.
- Avoids sales bias and explains component choices in plain language tailored to user expertise.
- Ensures final component list is compatible and practical for real-world purchasing.
